kinds.name: family_route_condition
kinds.satisfyingRow: the leaf's family row about the family whose disposition is rerouted, assigned, changed or retired (never no_impact), while the family record in K_C satisfies MIK-R04 including its rule 4 waivers or is retired (MIK-R06 rule 3); for route_unassigned the record's route set is non-empty (ruling Q3)
kinds.subject: family ID and route condition (<FAM-ID>#<condition>)

kinds.name: onboarding_trace
kinds.satisfyingRow: a counted change of the card's or overview's Markdown or sidecar between K_B and K_C (facts.countedChange), or the leaf's onboarding_trace row with this subject and disposition no_impact (MIK-R30 rules 2 and 7)
kinds.subject: onboarding card or route overview (onboarding:<path> | onboarding:<route>/overview)

kinds.name: planned_untouched
kinds.satisfyingRow: the leaf's planned row with this subject: realized_elsewhere (ref: the row or invariant that delivered it), deferred (ref: the follow-up requirement or leaf) or dropped (ref: a decision entry of the leaf's task document) (MIK-R11 rule 5)
kinds.subject: planned subject key (planned:<declared subject>#<effect>)

kinds.name: reached_family
kinds.satisfyingRow: the leaf's family row about the family (MIK-R07 rule 5)
kinds.subject: family ID

kinds.name: reconsideration_candidate
kinds.satisfyingRow: the leaf's reconsideration row with this subject: still_rejected (the rejection holds, with a reason) or raise (the decision becomes under_reconsideration and a question goes to the developer) (MIK-R14 rule 4)
kinds.subject: decision alternative (reconsider:<DEC-ID>#<alternative index>)

kinds.name: stale_invariant
kinds.satisfyingRow: the leaf's invariant row about the invariant (MIK-R07 rule 2)
kinds.subject: invariant ID

kinds.name: touched_invariant
kinds.satisfyingRow: the leaf's invariant row about the invariant (MIK-R07 rule 2)
kinds.subject: invariant ID

kinds.name: unexplained_file
kinds.satisfyingRow: covered file (a realization entry in K_B, or its governing route migrated): the leaf's no_invariant row with subject file:<path>@<blob> and a reason -- or attach/author an entry over the change, which links it (a delete-only hunk admits only no_invariant); uncovered file: the file's onboarding trace, a counted change of its card or its onboarding:<path> no_impact row (MIK-R10 rules 3-5)
kinds.subject: non-text change of one path (file:<path>@<C-side blob>)

kinds.name: unexplained_hunk
kinds.satisfyingRow: covered file (a realization entry in K_B, or its governing route migrated): the leaf's no_invariant row with subject hunk:<item id> and a reason -- or attach/author an entry over the change, which links it (a delete-only hunk admits only no_invariant); uncovered file: the file's onboarding trace, a counted change of its card or its onboarding:<path> no_impact row (MIK-R10 rules 3-5)
kinds.subject: changed lines of one hunk (hunk:<path>@<base lines sha256>..<candidate lines sha256>)
